H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H8141: a year (as a revolution of time)

H4467: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)

H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H2320: the new moon; by implication, a month
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H2608: Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H5809: Azzur, the name of three Israelites
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.

H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)

H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H5923: a yoke (as imposed on the neck), literally or figuratively
H894: Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire

H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)

H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)

H6677: the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)
H3602: just so, referring to the previous or following context

H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)

H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
